title: Other German Voices
welcome_lead: Other HL options include Kafka, Boll, Wolf, Seghers. Each opens a different German tradition.
meta_desc: German HL Literature: Kafka, Boll, Wolf, further options.

concepts.def: 1883-1924, Prague-born German-language writer of the surreal.

walkthroughs.body_html: Gregor Samsa wakes as a giant insect. The novella interrogates alienation in capitalist family structures. The opening sentence is iconic.
Die verlorene Ehre der Katharina Blum (1974) critiques tabloid press. Boll's prose is morally precise, politically engaged.
Der geteilte Himmel (1963) examines East-West division through a love story. Wolf later became critical of the GDR regime.
